comment: Token without the project scope reading board items. GitHub answers 200 with null data and an INSUFFICIENT_SCOPES error; message copied from a real response.

errors.message: Your token has not been granted the required scopes to execute this query. The 'projectV2' field requires one of the following scopes: ['read:project'], but your token has only been granted the: ['gist', 'read:org', 'repo'] scopes. Please modify your token's scopes at: https://github.com/settings/tokens.
